methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,015 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 209 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2018 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and omni-channel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools. Further, online and omni-channel retailers continue to focus on delivery services, as customers are increasingly seeking faster, guaranteed delivery times and low-price or free shipping, and we must make investments to keep up with our customers’ evolving shopping preferences.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'For purchases made on Lowes.com, customers may pick up their purchase in-store, have their purchase delivered from a store, or have their purchase parcel shipped.'. The stock trades at 21.1x FY19E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,015 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 209 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.75x; +32% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.52; conservative 2yr +11%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.3%/yr (FY19 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.4%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2019-12-31) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.75x (24.0% downside to Bear $91 / +31.9% upside to Bull $158) | Adj composite 2.34 vs market 2.86: gap -0.52 [OVERVALUED] | +32% above the EPP floor $91 (16x FY19E $5.67) | Conservative 2-yr case: +11.1% total (+5.6%/yr) | At 21.1x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $158 sits above the BULL case; comps +2.2% in Q3 FY19, forward sales +2% (FY19 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2018 10-K
